source_document.title_zh_hk: 自願醫保計劃認可產品保單範本
source_document.publisher: VHIS Office, Health Bureau, HKSAR Government
source_document.publisher_zh_hk: 香港特別行政區政府醫務衞生局自願醫保計劃辦事處
source_document.note: Paraphrased research notes only; verify the current official document before publication.
source_document.note_zh_hk: 只屬改寫後的研究筆記；發布前須核實最新官方文件。

chunks.text_zh_hk: 自願醫保係香港政府就個人償款住院保險產品推出的政策措施，保險公司及消費者都係自願參與。
chunks.text_en: VHIS is a Hong Kong Government policy initiative for individual indemnity hospital insurance; participation by insurers and consumers is voluntary.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 標準計劃包括不論受保人健康狀況有否改變，均保證續保至100歲。
chunks.text_en: The Standard Plan includes guaranteed renewal to age 100 regardless of changes in the insured person's health condition.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 標準計劃不設終生保障限額。
chunks.text_en: The Standard Plan has no lifetime benefit limit.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 標準計劃保障涵蓋投保時未知的已有病症；呢個概括說明唔等於任何個人索償保證。
chunks.text_en: The Standard Plan covers pre-existing conditions unknown at application; this general statement is not a guarantee for any individual claim.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 標準計劃涵蓋日間手術，包括按醫療需要進行的內窺鏡檢查。
chunks.text_en: The Standard Plan covers day case procedures, including endoscopy performed when medically necessary.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 認可產品可提供高於或有別於最低要求的條款及保障，所以具體答案仍須查閱個別保單。
chunks.text_en: Certified Plans may provide terms and benefits above or different from the minimum requirements, so product-specific questions require the actual policy.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 賠償按合資格費用的實際金額實報實銷，並受最高賠償額及分擔費用安排（如有）規限。
chunks.text_en: Benefits reimburse the actual amount of eligible expenses, subject to maximum benefit limits and any cost-sharing arrangement.

chunks.text_zh_hk: 保單範本規定冷靜期日數不得少於21日；實際程序及條件須查閱個別保單文件。
chunks.text_en: The policy template requires a cooling-off period of at least 21 days; the actual procedure and conditions must be checked in the specific policy documents.
